verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing and FAQ copy says it scores every release against production history (offline, in CI, and on live traffic), tracks drift over prompt versions and regressions across deploys, and keeps prompt and model changes versioned and diffable so a regression can be traced to its cause. However, nothing documents an actual side-by-side comparison view of two eval runs, and the claims are homepage/FAQ-level only. Missing for 10: documented side-by-side eval-run comparison UI or CLI, per-metric diff between runs, in-depth eval docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible. Trace any regression back to the change that caused it.
